title: Top notch guide
text: We are seasoned travelers who have worked with guides all over the world, and Uni was among the best we have ever had.  He was friendly, very personable and knowledgeable.  However, it went beyond that.  We had a non-standard plan because we needed to take baggage and head directly to the airport and had some very specific requirements.  He remembered every detail from advance communication and was ready for each part of the day.  He clearly loved the area we were visiting (Montserrat) and that came through in his enthusiasm. author: barow44

title: Jordy is the best!
text: Our guide, Jordy was wonderful. He was prompt, kind, funny, educated, informative and drove carefully which is greatly appreciated as we have people in our group that get motion sickness. Montserrat was a beautiful place. Unfortunately all Natural Parks were closed down that day due to wildfire risk so we didn’t get to do the nature walk, but he did his best to make it up to us in other ways.
author: angelahN2604JE

title: Amazing day in Montserrat
text: We had such a lovely time on this private tour. Uni was friendly, knowledgeable and made everything feel very relaxed from start to finish. The views were beautiful, and the whole experience felt very personal and flexible. The transport was also very comfortable. One of our favorite days in Barcelona.
author: H9857LHmichaelt

title: A really nice way to experience Montserrat
text: Uni was a great guide and shared lots of interesting information during the drive and the visit. The hike was easy and enjoyable, and since it was a private tour we could fully adapt the pace to ourselves and simply enjoy the surroundings. Definitely recommended
